h1: Addis Ababa travel, stays & events guide
heroText: Addis Ababa is Ethiopia's high-altitude capital and a diplomatic hub for Africa, home to the African Union headquarters and a fast-growing skyline. First-time visitors should explore the National Museum of Ethiopia to see the Lucy hominid fossil, browse the vast Mercato market, and walk the grounds of Holy Trinity Cathedral. Addis Ababa Bole International Airport is Ethiopian Airlines' main hub, connecting the city across Africa and beyond.

areas.name: Bole
areas.text: Bole is Addis Ababa's modern district near the airport, packed with international hotels, restaurants and the city's business towers.

areas.name: Kazanchis
areas.text: Kazanchis is a central business district close to the African Union headquarters and United Nations offices, popular with diplomats and conference visitors.

areas.name: Piazza
areas.text: Piazza is Addis Ababa's historic Italian-era district, with older architecture, markets and some of the city's oldest hotels.

areas.name: Old Airport / CMC
areas.text: The Old Airport and CMC areas offer quieter, more residential surroundings within a reasonable drive of the centre.

airports.name: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (ADD)
airports.search: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
airports.text: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport sits within the Bole district itself, keeping transfers to nearby hotels short even at peak traffic times.

airportTransfer.value: Compare road transfer time between Addis Ababa Bole International Airport (ADD) and central Addis Ababa before choosing an airport-area or city-centre hotel.

stayOverview: Base in Bole for easy airport access and a wide choice of international hotels, or Kazanchis for proximity to the African Union and conference venues. Piazza suits history-focused stays, while CMC offers a quieter, more residential alternative.
hotelIntro: Addis Ababa hotel choice usually follows purpose: Bole keeps the airport and business towers close, Kazanchis suits diplomats and conference travellers, Piazza appeals to history-minded visitors on a budget, and CMC offers calmer residential surroundings.
rentalCars: A rental car isn't essential given ride-hailing apps and taxis, though a hired driver helps for day trips outside the capital.

travelTips.title: Best base
travelTips.text: Choose Bole for airport convenience and international hotels, or Kazanchis for proximity to the African Union and conference venues.

travelTips.title: Altitude
travelTips.text: Addis Ababa sits above 2,300 metres, so pace the first day or two and stay hydrated while adjusting to the altitude.

travelTips.title: Getting around
travelTips.text: Use ride-hailing apps for reliable fares and easy communication, since traffic can be heavy and street addresses are inconsistent.

travelTips.title: Museum visits
travelTips.text: Visit the National Museum of Ethiopia early to see the Lucy fossil replica before tour groups arrive later in the morning.
